Company: Example Software Company
Role: Java Backend Engineer
Location: Hyderabad, India

We are looking for a Java Backend Engineer who will build REST APIs and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Candidates should have hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, relational databases including PostgreSQL, and Git.

Requirements:
- Mandatory: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Git.
- Preferred: Docker, Kafka, Kubernetes and GCP.
- Responsibilities: develop secure backend services, write tests, improve performance, review code, and troubleshoot production incidents.
